source_evidence.quote: Prepare the aggregate sensor briefing, a walk route map, two independent class packets, a school reception print bundle, the walk steward’s route copy, a public neighbourhood summary, and a private consent/incident note to me. Class Birch needs its first approved packet before its 10:35 planning circle, even if a later route check changes it. Class Cedar needs its own packet; one teacher cannot receive for both. If a crossing changes, replace or explicitly withdraw every affected held pack and steward copy before departure. Send the final current print bundle to the reception platform, not just a teacher message. A north-gate detour or an accessible school-garden loop is fine. The loop still needs separate class packs and a steward map. Keep truthful aggregate science results public; route changes alone do not require changing them. I have already booked one hands-on logger kit for each class: logger-Birch and logger-Cedar. The early planning packet can use the authorized garden route and aggregate observations, but mark it planning-only: hands-on measurements are not released until engineering supplies this session’s calibration sheet. Each final class pack must include its own kit-specific activity card, the engineering-release basis, raw test reading plus signed offset and corrected reading, and the actual completed bench-test proof for that kit. One kit’s proof cannot stand in for the other. Deliver both final activity packs to their own class desks and the actual reception bundle before departure. The aggregate-only planning packet cannot fulfil this final hands-on delivery. Route and public aggregate copies that remain accurate need no reprint merely because kit calibration is added.

Two-day aggregate: mean daytime temperature 18 C; four volunteer sensors; readings are educational observations, not a health or safety certificate. Publish aggregate only, without household locations or consent/payment information.

Bind the class packets to the actual map artifact; source edits never propagate into held snapshots.
